a high-density genetic map of 2575 SNP markers was used to identify 108 additive QQLs and 41 epistatic QQLs for stay-green and agro-morphological traits in wheat grown in diverse water regimes.
a high-density genetic map was used for mapping quantitative trait loci controlling stay-green and related agronomic traits under different water regimes.

we have mapped 108 additive QQL and 41 epistatic QQL for stay-green and 11 agronomic traits in a high-density genetic map of a recombinant inbred line population derived from the wheat cross ‘Chinese Spring’ × ‘Langdon’.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the identification of stable and major QTL controlling agronomic traits and stay-green in wheat under diverse environments, and it is expected that the identified QTL will facilitate the improvement of stay-green and agronomical traits in wheat.
the identification and validation of QTL for stay- green and agronomic traits under diverse water regimes in wheat.
the identification and mapping of QTL for agronomic traits under four diverse water conditions in wheat.

the genetic basis of stay-green and agronomical traits in wheat grown in diverse water regimes was complex and that the genetic architecture of these traits was affected by the environment.

stay-green and agronomical traits are controlled by additive, epistatic, and pleiotropic QTL, which could be utilized for marker-assisted breeding in wheat.
